integrity: Analytic proof with a standalone optional finite numerical checker; no claim of independent proof assessment, publication priority, or exhaustive global dynamics.
scientific_limitations: Strictly convex harmonic tables with \(n\ge6\) and \(0<\varepsilon<n^{-2}\); only two explicit symmetric periodic families. Scalar monodromy does not establish nonlinear bifurcation, and equivalent older or unindexed results remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact periodic-point spectra and resonance thresholds in harmonic outer billiards
